title: Executive Interview with Raghu Belur, Co-Founder of Enphase Energy - Semiwiki
gist: Enphase Energy, the residential solar microinverter leader (89.4M units shipped, 5.3M systems in 165+ countries), is pivoting its two decades of distributed power-electronics and custom-silicon expertise toward AI data centers with the IQ Solid-State Transformer (IQ SST), a single-stage medium-voltage-AC-to-800VDC converter built on proprietary Kestrel ASIC and GaN switching, targeting rack-scale demos in 2026, pilots in 2027 and volume shipments in 2028.

themes.theme: IQ SST: Solving AI Data Center Power Volatility

insights.claim: Enphase's IQ Solid-State Transformer (IQ SST) converts medium-voltage AC directly to 800 VDC or ±400 VDC for AI data centers in a single stage, responding in under a millisecond and spreading the load across hundreds of small, redundant modules.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Positions Enphase as a direct power-infrastructure supplier to AI data center buildouts, a new addressable market adjacent to its legacy residential solar business and a potential beneficiary of hyperscaler capex growth.
insights.quote: IQ SST converts medium-voltage AC directly to 800 VDC or ±400 VDC in a single stage, responds in under a millisecond and spreads the load across hundreds of small, redundant modules, so the system stays up and is easy to service.

insights.claim: AI is breaking the old data center power model because rack densities are climbing from hundreds of kilowatts toward a megawatt, and AI workloads swing rapidly between low and full power, which conventional architectures that stack transformers, UPS systems, converters and batteries cannot efficiently support.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Identifies a structural, physics-driven reason legacy power infrastructure vendors are exposed to disruption as rack power density scales toward megawatt levels — a thesis for why new entrants and power-electronics innovation are needed across the data center supply chain.
insights.quote: AI is breaking the old model for data center power. Rack densities are climbing from hundreds of kilowatts toward a megawatt, and AI workloads swing rapidly between low and full power.

insights.claim: IQ SST scales up to 5 MW rack deployments and can be paired with local battery storage near the compute or a centralized battery energy storage system that keeps batteries out of the white space and reduces maintenance near the racks.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Gives a concrete capacity benchmark (5MW/rack) for evaluating whether Enphase's platform can keep pace with next-generation AI rack power requirements.
insights.locator: What application areas are your strongest?

insights.claim: A 5 MW rack is designed to combine hundreds of intelligent IQ SST power modules into a coordinated 'supercluster' that keeps running with only 90% of modules active, supporting a 99.999% availability target, with modules that are hot-swappable without specialized technicians.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: The 99.999% availability target and tolerance for 10% module failure without downtime is a specific, testable reliability claim that data center operators will benchmark against alternative power architectures before committing capex.
insights.quote: A 5 MW rack is designed to combine hundreds of intelligent IQ SST power modules into a coordinated “supercluster” that keeps running with only 90% of modules active, supporting a 99.999% availability target.
insights.locator: What keeps your customers up at night?

insights.claim: The broader AI data center power industry is moving toward higher-voltage DC and rethinking conventional multi-stage architectures as rack power rises.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Signals an industry-wide architectural shift toward high-voltage DC data center power, a trend that should be validated against other power-infrastructure vendors and standards bodies (e.g., Open Compute Project) for corroboration.
insights.locator: What does the competitive landscape look like

insights.claim: Most competing solid-state transformer designs rely on a few large power blocks, so losing one takes out a big share of capacity, whereas Enphase's IQ SST distributes the work across hundreds of small modules instead.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: A differentiated reliability architecture (fine-grained module redundancy vs. large power-block designs) is Enphase's core competitive claim against rival solid-state transformer vendors entering the AI power market — worth validating against named competitors as the space matures.
insights.quote: Most solid-state transformer designs rely on a few large power blocks, so losing one takes out a big share of capacity. IQ SST distributes the work across hundreds of small modules instead.
insights.locator: What does the competitive landscape look like

insights.claim: Enphase brings 20 years of building distributed power systems at scale to data center power, including a ninth-generation microinverter platform, a fifth-generation ASIC, and approximately 2.5 GWh of battery storage shipped.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Prior-generation manufacturing scale and silicon design maturity (9th-gen microinverter, 5th-gen ASIC) is Enphase's argument for why it can execute a hardware roadmap that competitors without semiconductor manufacturing history may struggle to match on cost and reliability.
insights.quote: We’ve spent 20 years building distributed power systems at scale, with a ninth-generation microinverter platform, a fifth-generation ASIC and approximately 2.5 GWh of battery storage shipped, and we’re bringing that semiconductor, manufacturing and reliability experience to data center power.
insights.locator: We’re also not starting from scratch

insights.claim: Enphase Energy has shipped approximately 89.4 million microinverters and has about 5.3 million Enphase-based systems deployed in more than 165 countries, making it the world's leading supplier of microinverter-based solar and battery systems.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Establishes the installed-base scale underpinning Enphase's claimed manufacturing and reliability credibility as it enters the AI data center power market.
insights.quote: We are the world’s leading supplier of microinverter-based solar and battery systems, with approximately 89.4 million microinverters shipped and about 5.3 million Enphase-based systems in more than 165 countries.

insights.claim: IQ SST runs on Enphase's proprietary Kestrel ASIC and gallium nitride (GaN) power electronics for fast, efficient, software-controlled conversion.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Names the specific silicon (Kestrel ASIC) and power semiconductor technology (GaN) underlying the product, relevant for tracking Enphase's GaN supply-chain relationships and custom-silicon development costs.
insights.locator: What new features/technology are you working on?

insights.claim: Enphase expects to demonstrate full rack-scale IQ SST systems in 2026, begin customer pilots in 2027 and target volume shipments in 2028.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Gives a concrete, dated product roadmap (demo 2026, pilots 2027, volume 2028) that investors can use as milestones to track execution risk and revenue timing for Enphase's AI data center power business.
insights.quote: We expect to demonstrate full rack-scale systems in 2026, begin customer pilots in 2027 and target volume shipments in 2028.
insights.locator: IQ SST is our main focus

insights.claim: Enphase is expanding into commercial and industrial energy with the IQ Battery C80, its first commercial battery, which scales from 80 kWh to 2 MWh and is now open for pre-orders.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: A near-term (pre-order stage) product launch diversifying Enphase beyond residential solar into commercial/industrial energy storage, broadening revenue base ahead of the longer-dated IQ SST ramp.

insights.claim: For IQ SST, Enphase is working directly with hyperscalers, data center operators, developers, utilities and power-infrastructure partners, with each engagement starting from deployment specifics such as rack voltage, power density, utility interconnection, load profile, availability target and service model.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Confirms direct hyperscaler engagement (rather than only channel/distributor sales) as the go-to-market for the data center product line, implying longer sales cycles but potentially larger, stickier contracts than Enphase's traditional residential channel.
insights.locator: How do customers normally engage with your company?

insights.claim: Enphase is active in the Open Compute Project, helping shape open standards for higher-voltage DC power in data centers.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Standards-body participation is a positioning signal that Enphase is seeking to influence the emerging high-voltage DC data center standard in its own favor, which could shape competitive dynamics industry-wide.
insights.locator: We’re also active in the Open Compute Project
